candidates.snippet: Italy has assigned us the distant port of Civitavecchia, which is 900km away – around THREE DAYS of sailing away! Italian authorities are deliberately using distance as a weapon to prevent people from being rescued. We demand a closer port!

Our Sea-Watch 5 completed a third rescue early this morning! After being threatened by an actor identifying as the “Libyan Navy”, we were able to rescue another 72 people close to an oil platform. We now have 151 people on board!
